title: Project-Scoped CI/CD, Release & Deployment Integrity

canonicalDeployment.note: T39b, T44, T45, T49 attempt-identity fixture rot from Phase 140 repaired. Full suite 67/0 on this commit.

projectIsolationGuarantees: PipelineAgent.run resolves execution.project_id from the authoritative Execution KV row and rejects (as EXECUTION_NOT_FOUND) any caller-supplied projectId that disagrees.

All non-success paths inside PipelineAgent.run (missing project_id, project mismatch, non-member actor, insufficient project role) are masked as EXECUTION_NOT_FOUND, so unauthorized callers cannot use the error code as a project-existence oracle.

ProductionReleaseEnforcementService.requestRelease now resolves the authoritative execution.project_id via an optional engine dependency and BLOCKS on missing execution, missing project_id, or caller/authoritative mismatch.
ProductionExecutionAuthorization.projectId is populated from the authoritative resolved value, never from the raw caller-supplied assertion.
ReleaseRecoveryExecutor gates orchestrator.deploy behind a project-consistency check: execution missing or project mismatch blocks with RECOVERY_REQUIRED.

ReleaseDeploymentIntentService.computeKey does not include projectId (deliberate: project is not part of intent identity); a Phase-170-compatible bridge already overwrites req.projectId with the authoritative value before calling getOrCreate.
ExecutionStore remains the sole durable authority for execution â†’ project resolution. No project_id column was added to artifacts, evidence, or execution_jobs.
Caller-supplied projectId is an assertion everywhere; it is never treated as ownership.
